description: 1. Agent reads tools/installed_skills.md and/or ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/memory-palace/skill.yaml to understand the Memory Palace skill. 2. Agent reads the SKILL.md documentation to discover: (a) the memory/ directory structure with insights/ and daily/ subdirs, (b) the exact filename '00-概念定义.md' for the core identity file (Chinese characters!), (c) date-stamped files like YYYY-MM-DD.md in daily/, (d) the .memory-path config file that must be placed in the workspace ROOT. 3. Agent creates /workspace/my_knowledge_base/ directory with the required structure: insights/, daily/, and 00-概念定义.md. 4. Agent creates /workspace/.memory-path containing '/workspace/my_knowledge_base'. 5. Agent transforms temp/scratch/my_identity_raw.md into a properly structured 00-概念定义.md with 身份, 性格, and 核心原则 sections. 6. Agent creates date-stamped files (2026-03-20.md, 2026-03-22.md) in daily/ from the raw daily notes. 7. Agent creates at least one insights .md file in insights/ from the raw insights. The key traps: the exact Chinese filename '00-概念定义.md', the .memory-path config at workspace root (not inside memory dir), and the YYYY-MM-DD.md date format for daily files.
